kill_chain_signals.contact: automated phone call claiming to be financial institution, law enforcement, credit reporting agency or Amazon
kill_chain_signals.pretext: advising fraudulent transactions in account and requesting help in ongoing investigation
kill_chain_signals.payment: tell victim to transfer large amount of money to protect account or send funds as part of investigation
kill_chain_signals.movement: fraudsters add victim as payee with fraudulent email address and convince victim they added funds but actually took money from line of credit or savings
kill_chain_signals.cashout: suspects come to residence to pick up debit or credit card

red_flags: Criminals use Call-Spoofing to mislead victims
These institutions or law enforcement will never threaten you over the phone
Institutions or online merchants will never request transferring funds to an external account for security reasons
Institutions or police will never request you to turn over your bank card nor attend your residence to pick up your bank card
Don't share codes received via text message or email with anyone - these are multi-factor authentication codes
key_quote: Fraudsters will request access to your computer or device to continue the investigation.
